pathways.label: Renal (glomerular filtration)

raw_tm50.notes: 95% CI 45.1–50.5; adult GFR 121.2 mL/min/70 kg (95% CI 117–125) with allometric exponent 3/4.

pathways.citation: Rhodin MM, Anderson BJ, Peters AM, Coulthard MG, Wilkins B, Cole M, Chatelut E, Grubb A, Veal GJ, Keir MJ, Holford NH. Human renal function maturation: a quantitative description using weight and postmenstrual age. Pediatr Nephrol. 2009;24(1):67-76.
pathways.quote_or_table: Assuming an allometric coefficient of 3/4, the fully mature (adult) GFR is predicted to be 121.2 mL/min per 70 kg [95% CI 117–125]. Half of the adult value is reached at 47.7 post-menstrual weeks (95%CI 45.1–50.5), with a Hill coefficient of 3.40 (95%CI 3.03–3.80).

pathways.label: Hepatic CYP3A4 (midazolam IV clearance)

raw_tm50.notes: 95% CI 59.4–80.0; Hill 95% CI 2.2–4.1. Mature CL 523 mL·min⁻¹·70 kg⁻¹. Pooled published IV midazolam CL vs PMA; few data 44–80 weeks PMA.

pathways.citation: Anderson BJ, Larsson P. A maturation model for midazolam clearance. Paediatr Anaesth. 2011;21(3):302-308.
pathways.quote_or_table: CL maturation, standardized to a 70-kg person was described using the Hill equation. The maturation half-time was 73.6 (95%CI 59.4, 80.0) weeks PMA and the Hill coefficient 3 (95%CI 2.2, 4.1).

pathways.label: Hepatic UGT2B7 (morphine glucuronidation)

raw_tm50.notes: Anand 2008 Table 1: CLmat50 54.2 weeks (95% CI 50.3–60.5), HillCL 3.92 (95% CI 3.25–4.40). Pooled NEOPAIN preterm + Bouwmeester postoperative infants 0–3 y. Ventilated preterms have lower CL than the PMA curve. Anderson 2009 DMPK simultaneous re-fit: TM50 54.6 weeks, Hill 3.83.

pathways.citation: Anand KJS, Anderson BJ, Holford NHG, Hall RW, Young T, Shephard B, Desai NS, Barton BA; NEOPAIN Trial Investigators Group. Morphine pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics in preterm and term neonates: secondary results from the NEOPAIN trial. Br J Anaesth. 2008;101(5):680-689.
pathways.quote_or_table: Table 1: CLmat50 54.2 weeks (se 4.5%; 95% CI 50.3, 60.5); HillCL 3.92 (se 8.2%; 95% CI 3.25, 4.40). Abstract: Clearance was 50% that of the mature value at 54.2 weeks PMA (CLmat50). Equation: Hill sigmoid on PMA, allometry 70 kg.

pathways.label: Renal tubular secretion OAT1/OAT3 (amoxicillin ATS)

raw_tm50.notes: Cristea 2021 in-vivo functional CLint,OAT1,3. TM50 27.3 weeks PNA (RSE 28%, ~7 months); Hill 1.17 (RSE 36%). Critically ill children 1 month–15 y. PNA-based sigmoid, not PMA.

pathways.conversion: TM50_weeks_PMA ≈ 27.3 + 40 = 67.3 (term assumption). Paper used postnatal age, not PMA.
pathways.citation: Cristea S, Krekels EHJ, Allegaert K, De Paepe P, de Jaeger A, De Cock P, Knibbe CAJ. Estimation of ontogeny functions for renal transporters using a combined population pharmacokinetic and physiology-based pharmacokinetic approach: application to OAT1,3. AAPS J. 2021;23(3):65.
pathways.quote_or_table: Eq. 6: ont_OAT1,3 = COV^hill / (COV^hill + TM50^hill). CLint,OAT1,3,in vivo was found to reach half of the adult capacity at a PNA of 27.3 weeks (RSE of 28%), which is around 7 months. The rapid ontogeny of OAT1,3 was captured by a hill exponent of 1.17 (%RSE of 36%).

pathways.label: Renal OAT1/OAT3 protein abundance (not function)

raw_tm50.notes: Cheung 2019 LC-MS/MS protein in postmortem kidney cortex. TM50 30.7 weeks PNA (95% CI 16.64–50.97); Hill 0.51 (95% CI 0.35–0.71). Quoted verbatim in Cristea 2021 discussion of Cheung et al. Protein abundance ≠ in-vivo CL.

pathways.conversion: TM50_weeks_PMA ≈ 30.7 + 40 = 70.7 (term assumption). Paper used PNA weeks.
pathways.citation: Cheung KWK, van Groen BD, Spaans E, et al. A comprehensive analysis of ontogeny of renal drug transporters: mRNA analyses, quantitative proteomics, and localization. Clin Pharmacol Ther. 2019;106(5):1083-1092.
pathways.quote_or_table: Cristea quoting Cheung: 'children reaching half of the adult values around 8 months of age (TM50 = 30.7 weeks [95% CI: 16.64–50.97]) and the steepness of the ontogeny slope given by a hill coefficient of 0.51 (95% CI: 0.35–0.71).'
pathways.reject_reason: Hill+TM50 published, but this is protein abundance not clearance; Hill is shallow (0.51). Prefer Cristea in-vivo function if a single OAT key is added.

pathways.label: Paracetamol clearance (UGT1A1/1A6/1A9 + SULT; not a single isoform)

raw_tm50.notes: Anderson & Holford DMPK 2009 Table 1 / Table 3 separate-Hill fit: TM50 52.2 weeks (49.8–54.1), Hill 3.43 (3.19–3.96). Simultaneous common-Hill re-fit: TM50 50.1 weeks, Hill 3.4.

pathways.citation: Anderson BJ, Holford NHG. Mechanistic basis of using body size and maturation to predict clearance in humans. Drug Metab Pharmacokinet. 2009;24(1):25-36.
pathways.quote_or_table: Table 1: Maturation Hill coefficient 3.43 (3.19–3.96); TM50 (weeks) 52.2 (49.8–54.1). Table 3 separate: Hill paracetamol 3.43, TM50 paracetamol 52.2 weeks.
pathways.reject_reason: Verified Hill+TM50, but paracetamol CL is mixed UGT1A1/1A6/1A9 plus sulfation. Do not map this curve onto ugt1a1 (or any single UGT key).

pathways.label: Ibuprofen clearance (CYP2C9-predominant mixed; not a clean isoform curve)

raw_tm50.notes: 95% CI TM50 34.7–40.9; Hill 8.1–15. Very steep Hill. Drug-level popPK of published CL estimates, not isoform-resolved.

pathways.citation: Anderson BJ, Hannam JA. A target concentration strategy to determine ibuprofen dosing in children. Paediatr Anaesth. 2019;29(11):1100-1106.
pathways.quote_or_table: The maturation half-time was 36.8 (CV 9.2%, 95%CI 34.7, 40.9) weeks postmenstrual age and the Hill coefficient 11.5 (95%CI 8.1, 15).
pathways.reject_reason: Do not treat as CYP2C9 ontogeny. Rapid almost step-like maturation (Hill 11.5) is a drug CL descriptor; CYP2C9 is also genotype-dominated.

notes:
Engine form MF = PMA^H / (TM50^H + PMA^H) is algebraically identical to MF = 1 / (1 + [PMA/TM50]^(-H)) used by Anderson/Holford. All included TM50 values are PMA weeks except oat1_3 / oat1_3_protein, which were published as PNA weeks and converted with +40 (term). Do not convert values already in PMA weeks.

Current backend/engine/constants.py does NOT match opened primaries for CYP3A4 (55.4/1.83 vs 73.6/3) or UGT2B7 (88.3/1.90 vs 54.2/3.92). CYP1A2, CYP2D6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, UGT1A1 engine rows were not found in any opened paper and should be treated as unverified approximations.

Upreti 2016 is the highest-value unread source for a complete CYP Hill table (Age50 years PNA + Hill). Farhan 2024 is the analogue for UGTs. Both full texts were paywalled.

CYP2D6 / CYP2C9 / CYP2C19 should not be single Hill keys even if a TM50 is later found: genotype (PM/IM/EM/UM) dominates adult activity. CYP3A7 is declining and must not use a rising Hill.

Adult-normalization in the engine (MF_adult ≈ 1 at PMA 2080 weeks) is a separate step after the published raw Hill; published TM50/Hill above are the un-normalized published parameters.
